verdict.rationale: The docs show Claude Code working across many items at once: fixing lint errors across a whole project, writing code across multiple files, spawning multiple coordinated agents on subtasks in parallel, and running multiple tasks in parallel in the cloud. Its Unix-style composability (piping, CI) supports scripted batch use. One hands-on report says a bulk replace_all corrupted a constant definition, so bulk edits still need human verification. Missing for 10: a documented dedicated batch/bulk-operation mechanism (e.g., iterating a prompt over a list of files or items), independent corroboration of reliable large-scale bulk edits, and any stated limits or safeguards for bulk changes.
